$comment: Quality gates for the showrunner. 'activateAt' is the number of open candidates for an episode at which a gate switches on (0 = always on). Each episode repo gets a copy at creation; edit that copy to tune one episode.

gates.why: 'ask-first' ideas need a producer note containing 'consent confirmed'.
Borges, Leonardo and Agnolo have each worked on the idea.
The chosen approach says when it's done.
The chosen approach fits what's left of the episode's cash ceiling.
Story + business + participation reaches the minimum (of 9).
At least one vote from the community, or a creative judgment of 2+.
Not a near-duplicate of an idea already cut — merge it instead.
The producer has given it a creative signal.
